summary: Remove the non-BOM white showcase front-detail meshes (front posts, top/bottom front edges and glass-shelf front strips) from wall_showcase_100_2 and wall_showcase_100_3 while preserving canonical body boards, glass shelves, frame geometry, grouped body color behavior, state, persistence, placement, movement, rotation and BOM.

impactAnalysis.notes: Fresh Version2 review covered canonical identity/type, intrinsic/default ownership, factory/state, placement/move/rotation/snap/collision, selection/drag/context actions, persistence, relationships/reflow, BOM/composition and renderer ownership. The only runtime delta is deletion of renderer-only white meshes that have no canonical Item/BOM ownership: showcaseDetailMaterial/frontPost/frontEdge/shelfFront. The canonical frame, side/horizontal body boards, glass_shelf geometry, one grouped bodySurface color target, state shape, save/load and all placement behavior remain unchanged. Broad scene3d path-required domains are declared affected for Change Gate enforcement; their runtime behavior is explicitly regression-preserved. F-025/F-030 and audit remediation remain out of scope and are reviewedNotAffected only.

e2e.reason: scene3d renderer geometry changes are browser-impacting. Keep canonical showcase lifecycle plus smoke coverage through Chromium before merge.

risk.notes: Deletion-only showcase renderer cleanup. No Item, BOM, state schema, placement or persistence implementation changes.

migration.notes: No persisted state or storage schema changes.

rollback: Restore the renderer-only showcaseDetailMaterial frontPost/frontEdge/shelfFront meshes and revert the associated regression/documentation updates.
